type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : SeminormedRing R] {f P : Polynomial R} {A C : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : ℕ), ‖f.coeff i‖ ≤ A) →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), ‖P.coeff i‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ {s : ℕ},
        P.natDegree ≤ s →
          f ≠ 1 →
            P %ₘ f ≠ P →
              0 < f.natDegree ∧
                f.natDegree ≤ s ∧
                  ∃ (Q : Polynomial R), Q.natDegree ≤ s - 1 ∧ (∀ (i : ℕ), ‖Q.coeff i‖ ≤ (1 + A) * C) ∧ P %ₘ f = Q %ₘ f
